title: Cloudflare Domains Registry
description: Master registry of all Cloudflare-managed domains used across TriadicFrameworks, SI, RTT Suite, and Clarity Book ecosystems.

domains.name: triadicframeworks.com
domains.purpose: Main TriadicFrameworks site and canonical documentation hub.

domains.name: structuralintelligence.org
domains.purpose: Structural Intelligence publications, ontology, knowledge base, and semantic API.

domains.name: claritybook.ai
domains.purpose: Clarity Book chapters, pedagogy, triadic learning, dimensional curriculum.

domains.name: rttsuite.dev
domains.purpose: RTT Suite API endpoints, evaluator pipeline, semantic router.

domains.name: triadic.cloud
domains.purpose: Cloudflare Workers, AI Marketplace adapter, model registry, platform utilities.

domains.name: ecosystem.tf
domains.purpose: Cross-domain ecosystem registry, module discovery, metadata federation.

metadata.author: Nawder Loswin
metadata.notes: All domains use Cloudflare Pro features including Page Shield, Super Bot Fight Mode, WAF ruleset, and AI bot instructions via robots.txt.
